mapper.sql: select task_id, document_id, document_version_id, task_type, status, attempt_count, max_attempts, trace_id, request_file_hash, result_file_hash, page_count, block_count, character_count, error_code, error_message, started_time, finished_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from oc_document_task
mapper.insert: insert into oc_document_task ( document_id, document_version_id, task_type, status, attempt_count, max_attempts, trace_id, request_file_hash, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{documentId}, #{documentVersionId}, #{taskType}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{maxAttempts}, #{traceId}, #{requestFileHash}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update oc_document_task set status = '1', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, error_code = null, error_message = null, started_time = sysdate(), finished_time = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and status = '0' and attempt_count < max_attempts

update oc_document_task set status = '0', trace_id = #{traceId}, result_file_hash = null, page_count = null, block_count = null, character_count = null, error_code = null, error_message = null, started_time = null, finished_time = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and status = '3' and attempt_count < max_attempts

update oc_document_task set status = '0', trace_id = #{traceId}, result_file_hash = null, page_count = null, block_count = null, character_count = null, error_code = null, error_message = null, started_time = null, finished_time = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and status = '1' and attempt_count < max_attempts

update oc_document_task set status = '0', max_attempts = greatest(max_attempts, attempt_count + 1), trace_id = #{traceId}, result_file_hash = null, page_count = null, block_count = null, character_count = null, error_code = null, error_message = null, started_time = null, finished_time = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and status = '3'

update oc_document_task set status = '2', result_file_hash = #{resultFileHash}, page_count = #{pageCount}, block_count = #{blockCount}, character_count = #{characterCount}, error_code = null, error_message = null, finished_time = sysdate(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and status = '1'

update oc_document_task set status = '3', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_time = sysdate(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and status in ('0', '1')
